thread:
maria: thinking out loud — we need a concise UX for the automatic continuity policy in Console. current 'fallback' language is confusing to PMs and legal. can we call it 'continuity' or 'resilience'? :thinking:
srinivas: +1 on name change. 'continuity' sounds less like failure and more like intent. main UX question: show users when a request was served by a degraded mode vs. auto-switched model?
devon: we should show it, but not spam logs. maybe a compact badge per response and a detailed audit record on the rollout page.
eva: agree — badge at the request level (tooltip with reason), full audit entry with trigger + policy snapshot. needs to include the exact model variant and quantization used.
maria: proposal: 3 degrade modes in UI — "soft-throttle" (latency-first, partial responses), "offload" (route to cheaper variant), "failover" (route to fallback model). small icons + color semantics.
srinivas: add an "observe-only" sampling mode that doesn't affect production routing but records decisions for 48h. critical for trust.
devon: telemetry: we need per-policy counters: decisions, sampled decisions, reason buckets (latency, OOM, rate-limit, internal-error), and average client latency pre/post.
eva: + also emergency flag in audit entries if decision triggered by >5% error spike in last minute. ops will want that highlighted.
maria: API debate — should SDK include an opt-in header to allow silent degradations? e.g., `X-Continuity-Mode: observe|enforce` so customer apps can opt-out of enforced offloads.
srinivas: worried about fragmentation if too many knobs. default should be `enforce`, but Console toggles per-route override. provide SDK header as escape hatch for experiments.
devon: UI microcopy: explain 'observe' clearly — "No traffic rerouted; we record what would have happened." That will help customers validate policies.
eva: audit schema suggestion (very compact):
```
{ "ts":"...", "policy_id":"c-123", "decision":"offload", "trigger":"latency>p95", "variant":"gpt-small-q4", "sampled":true }
```
should be in the audit log.
maria: UX for audit playback — allow replay of sampled requests in sandbox with same prompt + policy snapshot. ops-only access.
srinivas: legal asked for tamper-evidence: add a signature/hash on policy snapshots included in audit entries. simple HMAC with key rotation.
devon: can we show an aggregated "continuity impact" graph on the route page? tokens saved, error rate delta, latency delta. customers want simple economics.
eva: yes — and a table of "Top triggers" with example request ids (link to audit playback).
ops-bot: system: policy.c-123 transitioned from observe -> enforce by maria at 2401234600 :white_check_mark:
maria: next steps: mockups for icons + audit page, wire up telemetry counters (srinivas), small API spec for `X-Continuity-Mode` (devon). I'll collect and sync with PMs on Friday.
srinivas: I'll add a sampling rate param in the policy spec: `sampling_rate: 0.01` (default 0.001).
devon: noted — will stub SDK header in the beta client and add docs.
eva: I'll draft the audit schema PR and include HMAC fields.
maria: cool — thanks all. layering note: we should avoid adding new long-lived toggles in Console until we have a migration plan. keep it behind feature-flag for now. :thumbsup:
